events.text:
The trader has to cross three water cells to reach the door island, but only one boulder is on its island. The other two boulders are on a northern island, so the mirror has to carry the trader there and the mirror itself has to be relocated. I traced every step by hand against the rules; I could not run it.

**Plan**

1. **Bridge to the middle island.** Push boulder (21,21) to (22,21), then north along column 22 into the water at (22,18). It sinks and becomes floor. Walk to (18,17) on the middle island.
2. **Teleport to the left island.** Press `X` at (18,17). The mirror's east face sees the trader at distance 3, so it lands at (15,20).
3. **Move the mirror north.** Walk up and push the mirror from (15,17) to (15,12). Return to (15,17) and press `X`. The south face sees the trader at distance 5, so it lands at (20,12) on the north island.
4. **Bridge (21,14).** Push boulder (22,12) west to (21,12), then south twice. It sinks at (21,14) and links the north island to the middle island.
5. **Bridge (17,17).** Push boulder (23,10) west to (21,10). Then push it south along column 21 to (21,17), and west along row 17 until it sinks at (17,17). This links the middle island to the left island.
6. **Move the mirror east.** Walk back to the left island and push the mirror back down to (15,17). Then push it east along row 17 to (21,17).
7. **Cross to the door island.** Walk round the mirror through (22,16) and (22,17), then south along column 22 to (22,21), and step west to (21,21). Press `X`. The south face sees the trader at distance 4, so it lands at (25,17). Walk to the door at (27,16).
